messages:
Sam (AE): Heads up — TenX procurement sent back the MSA with heavy redlines and is insisting on BYOK + KMS clause. They also want Net45 unless we pre-sign the MSA. Can legal triage?

Leah (TenX): Confirming — procurement wants the MSA + DPA signed before they release the PO. If we can pre-sign the MSA we can submit PO same day. Also need invoice to show setup fee separately.

Priya (Sales Ops): What are the exact redlines? Pls paste or link. Also FYI billing entity: TenX Global Inc. Payment terms: Net45 default but negotiable to Net30 with credit approval.

Sam (AE): Link to redlines: https://box.com/s/tenx-msaredlines-abc123 (internal copy). Quick highlights from their markups:
- Sect 2.1: change "no export" -> broader "no transfer" language
- Sect 5: require customer-managed KMS/HSM and BYOK support
- Exhibit B: SLA bumped to 99.95% and specific MTTR/credits table
- Add 7 year data retention audit language

Jenna (Legal): Thanks. I can triage. BYOK ask is non-standard (we have BYOK for Private deployments but TenX wants it for Hosted/Dedicated). Need to know: are they asking for BYOK across hosted? or only for Dedicated/Private?

Devon (SE): Technical note: Redwood's standard Hosted SaaS does not support customer-managed keys. Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem) can support BYOK/HSM. If TenX needs BYOK, we'll need to specify deployment mode and possible infra implications (setup + ops).

Leah (TenX): They want BYOK for encryption at rest for customer data. They prefer Dedicated capacity in us-west.

Marco (Finance): Quick finance check: Net45 is fine but delays cash flow. We can accept Net45 for enterprise with PO if we get exec sign-off and risk review. For Net30 we need a credit check and AR approval. Invoices should go to ar@redwood.com and reference PO#.

Priya (Sales Ops): DocuSign routing question: procurement requires 3 signers on our side — AE, Legal, Finance. On their side it's Leah + Procurement. Do we want to pre-sign (i.e., our signers sign first) to speed PO?

Jenna (Legal): I will prepare a counter-redline that keeps BYOK limited to Dedicated/Private and adds specific acceptance criteria for key management. Proposed snippet I will add (tracked changes):

```text
Customer-managed encryption keys ("BYOK"): Customer may provide keys via an approved KMS/HSM provider. BYOK is supported when the Service is deployed in Dedicated or Private modes as defined in Exhibit A. Redwood will not have persistent access to customer keys; key usage is logged; key rotation and compromise procedures are subject to Section 9.
```

Jenna (Legal): Also proposing SLA compromise: keep 99.9% in MSA, add Exhibit B with optional 99.95% SLA for Dedicated at higher monthly commitment and with defined credits. That buys flexibility.

Devon (SE): Confirmed — we can offer 99.95% for Dedicated pools with pinned capacity and SLA-backed commitments. There will be a setup/config fee for the BYOK integration (HSM binding, KMS onboarding).

Sam (AE): Sounds reasonable. Leah — would TenX accept Dedicated + payment of setup fee (one-time) to get BYOK + higher SLA?

Leah (TenX): They will consider it if the total TCO remains within budget. Can you provide an order form with line items: Dedicated-1 (monthly), setup (one-time), BYOK integration (one-time), and invoice cadence monthly?

Marco (Finance): I can produce an accepted invoice schedule once we have the exact amounts. Pricing submitted: Dedicated-1 = $9,000/mo, Setup = $15,000 one-time, BYOK integration = $6,500 one-time. Payment terms Net30 if we pre-approve credit, otherwise Net45.

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll draft the order form and put placeholders for PO#. Also will set up DocuSign envelope for the MSA + Exhibit B. Who should be in the envelope? Proposed signers: Leah (TenX), Sam (AE), Jenna (Legal), Marco (Finance).

docusign-bot: Envelope created: env_0a9b2c — https://docusign.com/env/0a9b2c (Access: internal only)

Priya (Sales Ops): Routing note: we'll set signing order: Redwood Legal -> Redwood Finance -> AE -> Customer (Leah). That way legal cuts the countersign redline and finance confirms payment terms before customer signs.

Sam (AE): Good. Jenna — can you turn your redline into a tracked-change PDF by EOD so we can attach to the envelope?

Jenna (Legal): Yes — will produce tracked changes + a redline summary. ETA by 6pm PT.

Devon (SE): I'll prepare a short DR/ops note about BYOK requirements to add to the order form (networking, HSM vendor, lead time ~2-3 weeks).

Marco (Finance): Once Jenna's redline and Devon's ops note are in, I can approve Net30 contingency and sign in envelope.

Leah (TenX): Great — procurement will fast-track once final MSA + order form show BYOK and the invoice split. If you can pre-sign legal+finance we'll try to send PO same day.

Sam (AE): Plan summary: Jenna (Legal) redlines by EOD; Devon (SE) writes BYOK ops note; Marco (Finance) confirms invoice T&Cs and will be in envelope; Priya (Sales Ops) creates envelope and order form. I'll coordinate with TenX procurement. Meeting if needed tomorrow AM. 

Priya (Sales Ops): Created order form draft: https://internal.redwood.com/orderforms/tenx-draft-2445556666 (internal). I'll ping when envelope is live. :white_check_mark:

Sam (AE): Thanks all. Leah — any blocker from your side?

Leah (TenX): No blockers. Procurement wants the tracked redline and the order form with line items. Will stand by.

Jenna (Legal): Uploading redline now to the envelope.

docusign-bot: Envelope env_0a9b2c updated — Jenna uploaded: TenX_MSA_redline_tracked.pdf

Priya (Sales Ops): Envelope now routing. Finance -> Legal -> AE -> Customer.

Marco (Finance): Signed (placeholder) once credit cleared.

Sam (AE): Closing loop — will follow up after customer signs and PO is received. Thanks team :rocket:
